title: Estate Review Session Failure Rate
dataSources: Trust documents (`trust:document`), will status logs (`will:status`), power-of-attorney records (`poa:record`), and estate review sessions (`estate:review`).
app: Trust document vault exports, will status trackers, power-of-attorney records, and estate review checklists forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=estate:review
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(review_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by review_type
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often estate review session records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each review type.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize review_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per review type.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which parts of your estate review session data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
